n: the positive integer giving the size of the matrix
x_i: the real number in the ordered list with index i
A: the n-by-n Vandermonde matrix whose (i,j)-entry is x_i^(j-1)
C_k: the k-th column of that matrix, where 1<=k<=n
i: a row index and the first index in a product pair
j: the second index in a product pair
C: the residual (n-1) by (n-1) matrix defined explicitly in the proof
k: a column index used in the induction proof
D_n: the determinant of the n-by-n matrix displayed on the left-hand side of the identity
t: an auxiliary real variable used in the inductive step
p(t): the determinant obtained by replacing the last row of the size-n Vandermonde matrix by (1,t,t^2,...,t^{n-1})
c: the constant quotient in the factorization of p(t) by the factors t-x_i for 1<=i<=n-1
B: the matrix obtained from A by the specified descending column replacements
B': the submatrix of B obtained by deleting its first row and first column
C_j: the j-th column of A before it is replaced
y_r: the r-th real variable used in the induction hypothesis
